title: Silver Lake & Saudi Arabia's Private Investment Fund are reportedly in talks to acquire Unity, a game developement engine that has recently added numerous AI features.
author: humanquester
selftext:
Silver Lake - owned by United States President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner - and Saudi Arabia's Private Investment Fund, which just did the largest leveraged buyout in history when it acquired EA, saddling it with 20 billion in debt, are now in talks to acquire Unity. 

The sources for the Reuters report also state that the deal would take the form of a leveraged buyout, much like the Electronic Arts deal which purchased the company with funds that would need to be recouped by its operating profit. While not being the record-breaking numbers the EA acquisition boasted, this would still be one of the biggest leveraged buyouts in history.
